title: John Cage on silence
license: unknown (interview excerpt from Miroslav Sebestik's 'Listen', 1992; YouTube upload)
notes: three whole thoughts, the owner's cut: traffic on Sixth Avenue — sound is acting, I don't need sound to talk to me (0:14–0:54); Kant — music and laughter don't have to mean anything (3:07–3:39); the sound I prefer is silence, and silence now is traffic; Beethoven is always the same, traffic always different (3:44–4:17).
